scoring_justification: Fields are recomputed from analytic formulas on the agent's grid; energies are recomputed from physical constants. Strict tolerances ensure genuine numerical evaluation.

outputs.description: Gridded field distributions of excess dislocation density and stress components, plus the derived screening parameters.
Elastic energies of unscreened and screened disclination and their ratio.

output_contract.notes: All computations are based on the analytic expressions from the self-consistent field approximation; no external dataset is required.

steps.description: Recompute excess dislocation density and stress fields on agent grid, compare elementwise; also verify derived parameters.
Recompute unscreened and screened energies and ratio from reference parameters; compare with agent values.
